csv_project_name: Plan for Strategic Intermodal System (SIS) Studies IQC
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Florida , Department of transportation , may be seeking a Consultant to provide Consultant Services authorized by Task Work Orders to provide the Department with support to develop and implement the requirement of a Five Year Work Program, Ten Year Program, Cost Feasible Plan and a Multimodal Needs Plan for the SIS. The Constultant will provide general assistance to the Department to identify needs on the SIS and SIS Connectors and recommend solutions for implementation of the needs on the SIS. Tasks may incorporate all or parts of the SIS system. Tasks may include (but not limited to): operational analysis related to SIS facilities; analysis of criteria and production of status summary reports, Action Plans, Master Plans, Conceptual Design Plans, Interchange reports, and Corridor studies; review of documents, applications; preparation of maps, graphics, charts, and spreadsheets; Technical support; Data collection and analysis; and any additional items necessary to support the D7 needs.
